keyFindings.description: The Stage 4b `boot` checkpoint row was written back truncated: 2228 characters at the fork point, 771 at the head, ending in a literal `…` with no closing `|` — the documented contract of capabilities-at-boot.json (every image row present, every live row unchecked, open rows secrets plus pool-capacity when the pool scaled, model-fallback and resource-limits present) is gone and the table row is broken. Restore the fork-point row and re-apply only the intended edit (drop `and none installed`).

The notices stage's pin guard `[ -n "$typescript_version" ] && [ -n "$tsls_version" ] && [ -n "$pyright_version" ];` fails the build only when the LAST pin is empty: under `set -e` a non-last member of an AND list is ignored (verified: `sh -c 'set -eu; a=""; b=x; c=y; [ -n "$a" ] && [ -n "$b" ] && [ -n "$c" ]; echo REACHED'` prints REACHED, exit 0). An empty typescript or typescript-language-server pin ships THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES naming `TypeScript ,`. Check each pin on its own (`: "${typescript_version:?...}"` or `|| exit 1`).

Still says the language servers are npm global packages under /opt/node/lib/node_modules and that TypeScript is pinned to the version this repository's lockfile holds; this diff moved them to /opt/language-servers/node_modules installed by `npm ci --ignore-scripts` from packages/daemon/docker/language-servers's own package.json and lockfile. The notices text and the Dockerfile comments were updated; this paragraph was missed.

The image-probe row now reads `model-fallback=<on|off|unread>`, but live_install_test.go:324 (unchanged) refuses any mark but on or off, and the PR body's census says Stage 4a stays strict by design. Keep `<on|off>` in the row.

The capacity-stop test's positive case gives the attempt a 900 ms budget against a real 600 ms age-out with recheckInterval 500 ms: the informer must deliver the nudge within 300 ms or the case fails on a loaded runner. Widen the budget past the next recheck tick (e.g. bootTimeout + 1 s) so the tick is a second chance.

lastBytes glues `…` onto the first retained line (`"…" + string(buf)`), so that line no longer starts at a line boundary for the `(?m)^`-anchored OK-line readers (bootprobe.markPattern); unreachable today since the OK line is last. `"…\n"` keeps the retained lines intact. Hardening.

The 1 MiB io.LimitReader is itself a from-the-start cut, so the body's "the OK line is always in the quote" holds only while the last 100 lines fit in 1 MiB; unreachable with today's probe output bounds. Recorded under Not proven / risk, not a change requested.

The relative-element case uses `relative/bin`, which does not exist, so it cannot tell `skipped as relative` from `absent`; create the executable under a cwd-relative directory to prove the skip. Fast-follow.

Cleanup bundle for the Fast-follow line: pathValue duplicates capabilities.envValue(env, "PATH") (a lookpath.In(env, name) would own the whole job); StatusMissing/StatusReported exported though the wire must never carry them; render's ctx and error exist for one caller and Report discards both; ProbeBudgetLine's bool duplicates line != ""; TestStateStringIsTheProbeLine pins the line format a third time; the PR body's census row for the lookpath relative-skip should name the hazard it closes (an executable resolved from a cwd-relative PATH element, Go's exec.LookPath ErrDot).
